newsitem.title: CHINA: Trade in Liu Chong Hing Inv suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Liu Chong Hing Inv suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Liu Chong Hing Investment Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Friday.
The company's shares ended HK$1.55 or 13.6 percent up at HK$12.95 on Thursday on volume of 3.44 million shares.

Trading in the shares of the company's 53.68-percent controlled Liu Chong Hing Bank Ltd had been suspended on Thursday pending an announcement amidst rumours that COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd might increase its stake in the bank.
COSCO (Hong Kong), the parent of COSCO Pacific Ltd, has a five percent stake in Liu Chong Hing bank.
